After 3 years of experience with free-farrowing pens, Mathieu Le Nouvel is confident to say that free-farrowing management no longer holds many secrets. One of the key lessons he learned is that sows perform better when they are not confined before and during farrowing. Therefore, the pens are not closed until the piglets have been born.
